headlines.title: New twist in critical Michigan Senate race
headlines.description: Rep. Haley Stevens has pulled her endorsement of her party’s nominee Abdul El-Sayed, and has announced she is now backing his Republican opponent Mike Rogers in the Michigan Senate race. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports.

headlines.title: 5 charts that explain the economy’s role in the midterm elections
headlines.description: On Election Day, Americans will answer the question of whether they’re better off than they were two years ago when they cast ballots in the midterms.

headlines.title: Federal judge dismisses Trump attempt to interfere in Alaska Senate race
headlines.description: The president had requested that Alaska segregate ballots cast for a candidate with the same name as the incumbent. The judge said that would “violate Alaskans’ right to a secret ballot.”

headlines.title: Go Behind the Scenes of NBC News’ Decision Desk
headlines.description: TODAY’s Savannah Guthrie goes behind-the-scenes with the NBC News team tasked with calling election night’s pivotal races from coast-to-coast.

headlines.title: Fiery plane crash in Florida
headlines.description: A private jet crashed into a South Florida neighborhood killing all nine people on board according to transportation secretary Sean Duffy. The plane was flying from Austin, Texas to the Bahamas when it crashed. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch has the latest.

headlines.title: Fake alerts warn of nuclear danger as Ukraine and Russia report emergency app hacks
headlines.description: Nuclear danger, radiation threat and street combat: Ukrainians received a wave of messages Sunday night that raised alarm with a series of grave — and baseless — warnings.

headlines.title: It looked like more Mahomes magic. Then the Broncos won a nail-biter — again.
headlines.description: In a season full of one-score games, the Denver Broncos outlasted Kansas City on the final play. Denver has the league’s best record in close games.

headlines.title: Elementary school in middle of 11 data centers
headlines.description: NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk investigates how 11 data centers ended up being within half a mile of an elementary school in northern Virginia and what the backup generators with those centers could be doing to the air quality.

headlines.title: Democrats in key battlegrounds throw Joe Biden under the bus on the border
headlines.description: Democratic candidates in 2026 battleground races are criticizing Joe Biden’s handling of border security, seeking to neutralize a political vulnerability.

headlines.title: ‘Looks like Mars’: Toxic smog from Indonesia wildfires sparks health crisis, protests
headlines.description: Wildfires in Indonesia are blanketing the country and other southeast Asian nations in toxic smog, prompting widespread protests.

headlines.title: Affording America: For a traveling carnival, rising costs mean a bumpy ride
headlines.description: Blake Huston is a third generation carnival operator who has been around the business all his life. But rising gas, labor and insurance costs are all taking a toll on his bottom line and threatening the industry he calls a way of life.
